nodes.label: SHAP Beeswarm - Aerobic
nodes.rationale: Top drivers: acc_mag_std (low values strongly negative), acc_y_mean, acc_sma, acc_y_std, acc_entropy (high pushes positive), temp_min, acc_z_mean, acc_mag_mean, temp_max (low-value outliers ~+4.5), eda_min. Mostly movement features.

nodes.label: SHAP Beeswarm - Amusement
nodes.rationale: Top drivers are EDA: eda_std, eda_range (high values push against amusement), eda_min (high pushes toward); then acc_energy, acc_z_mean, acc_sma, eda_max, temp_max, acc_mag_mean, acc_x_mean. Amusement is the class most often rejected by the confidence threshold.

nodes.label: SHAP Beeswarm - Anaerobic
nodes.rationale: Top drivers: acc_y_mean and acc_sma (high values push toward anaerobic, up to ~+3), acc_y_std, acc_mag_std, acc_x_mean, temp_mean, temp_min, acc_mag_mean, acc_z_mean, eda_std. Dominated by accelerometer.

nodes.label: SHAP Beeswarm - Baseline
nodes.rationale: Top drivers: acc_z_mean (high values strongly negative, i.e. wrist orientation), acc_x_mean, acc_y_std, eda_min, acc_mag_mean, hr_mean (high pushes against baseline), eda_max (high strongly negative), temp_slope, eda_slope, acc_y_mean. Orientation features suggest posture/protocol cues rather than physiology.

nodes.label: SHAP Beeswarm - Emotion
nodes.rationale: Top drivers: acc_x_mean (high values strongly negative, to -5), acc_mag_mean, acc_y_mean, acc_z_mean, temp_min, acc_x_std, acc_sma, temp_max (high-value outliers ~+4), eda_scr_count (high pushes toward emotion), acc_mag_std. Wrist orientation dominates, consistent with dataset/posture identity rather than affect.

nodes.rationale: Across global and per-class SHAP, accelerometer mean/orientation and movement features rank highest, so the legacy six-class model leans on movement and wrist posture; the revision later shows physiology alone reaches 0.80 vs 0.83 with all modalities on the stress task.

nodes.label: Accelerometer features dominate legacy six-class SHAP importance
nodes.norm_label: accelerometer features dominate legacy six-class shap importance
nodes.rationale: Across the bar, heatmap, beeswarm and RF comparison, wrist accelerometer means (orientation/posture) are the top predictors for every class including Stress.
